description.value: This study compared longitudinal brain structural changes in individuals at elevated genetic risk of schizophrenia who did and did not use cannabis between scans, using tensor-based morphometry.

spans.text: In the current study we sought to extend these findings, using a fully automated image analysis technique to compare longitudinal brain structural changes in individuals from this high-risk cohort who did and did not use cannabis during the time between the scans.

description.value: Longitudinal observational study of individuals at elevated genetic risk of schizophrenia, with MRI assessments at baseline and approximately 2-year follow-up; cannabis exposure between scans was dichotomized and the groups were compared.

spans.text: Assessments were repeated after approximately 2 years in consenting participants who had enrolled in the first 2 years of the study and had not made the transition to schizophrenia.
Differences in the modulated difference images (from step 5) between high-risk subjects who did and did not consume cannabis between T1 and T2 were compared in SPM5 using the general linear model.
